articles.title: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says - TechCrunch
articles.description: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."
articles.content: AI hasnt benefited the bottom line of any big corporations outside the tech industry, according to a note recently published by the chief economist at Apollo Global Management (the private equity gia… [+1121 chars]
